WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.event_payload, e.context_payload
  FROM lab.media_events e
)
SELECT CASE
         WHEN get_json_object(event_payload, '$.media_category') = 'recording'
           THEN get_json_object(event_payload, '$.media_id')
         ELSE get_json_object(context_payload, '$.media_id')
       END AS media_id,
       get_json_object(context_payload, '$.session_id') AS session_id
FROM base
